name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates, and Josiah went against him and was slain at Megiddo.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: Pharaohnechoh bound him at Riblah so he might not reign, put the land to a tribute of silver and gold, and made Eliakim the son of Josiah king, turning his name to Jehoiakim.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: Jehoiakim taxed the people to pay Pharaoh, exacting the silver and gold of every man of the land, and he also did evil in the sight of the Lord like his forefathers, not like his father Josiah.

note.label: 2 Kings 23: Josiah Reads the Law and Cleanses the Land

points: After this, Necho king of Egypt comes up to fight at Carchemish by Euphrates, and Josiah goes out against him though Necho sends word that his war is not with Josiah and that God had commanded him to make haste.
Josiah will not turn his face but disguises himself to fight, hearkening not to the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and the archers shoot him in the valley of Megiddo.

The word of the Most High came to Jeremiah against the gentiles, against Egypt and the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt by the river Euphrates at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim.

The Most High will punish the multitude of No, Pharaoh, and Egypt with their gods and their kings, delivering them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar and his servants; afterward it shall be inhabited as in the days of old.
